title: 13 Best Employee Engagement Platforms That Turn Feedback Into Real Action in 2026
summary: Explore the 13 best employee engagement platforms in 2026. Compare AI features, feedback tools, analytics, and action planning to find the right fit for your HR team.
body_markdown:
Employee engagement platforms have become a key defense against a workforce that is quietly disengaging, and the numbers support this. We found that 34% of employees are actively job hunting right now, while 45% experienced a major workload spike last year. The market is changing toward[live insights and AI-driven action](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/7-ai-employee-engagement-platforms-that-turn-survey-data-into-real-action) , rather than annual scorecards alone. This piece reviews the best employee engagement platforms, including inFeedo AI, and helps HR teams use workplace engagement data to make measurable changes.


## 1. inFeedo AI — Best suited to AI-led employee listening and feedback-to-action programs


Image Source:[inFeedo AI](https://www.infeedo.ai/)


The **employee engagement platforms** designed to improve enterprise retention include inFeedo AI, which treats feedback as an ongoing conversation instead of a yearly checklist. Its[AI assistant Amber](https://www.infeedo.ai/conversational-ai-chatbot) draws on nine years of People Science research and more than 80 million employee responses. That gives the platform a data foundation that most **employee engagement survey platforms** cannot match.


### inFeedo AI feedback collection and action-planning capabilities


Amber contacts staff through Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, WhatsApp, email, and the web app. Employees can respond through the channels they already use. This broad channel coverage led to a 90% survey response rate during testing, which aligns with the 90%+ response rates reported across the platform. Amber also asks "why" after a negative score and attaches a reason to each low rating, so HR teams do not need to guess. The platform can generate up to five[AI-recommended action steps](https://www.infeedo.ai/action-planning) for each feedback thread. It assigns an owner, uses role-based access for leaders to monitor their own actions or their teams' actions, and checks back later to confirm whether the solution worked.


### inFeedo AI strengths, limitations, and best-fit HR teams


The proprietary PTM (People-To-Meet) algorithm uses more than 97 million responses to flag attrition risk 60 to 90 days before an employee resigns. This matters because silent employees are three times more likely to leave than survey respondents. Managers have time to discuss career paths or adjust responsibilities before an employee's departure becomes final. The platform needs consistent employee participation to improve its predictive accuracy over time. Organizations without an established feedback culture may also need more time to achieve strong response rates. Global capability centers and distributed engineering organizations with limited HRBP coverage often see the greatest value.


### inFeedo AI integrations and implementation requirements


inFeedo AI offers 100+ integrations with more than 35 systems, such as Darwinbox, Workday, and SAP SuccessFactors. It also supports conversations in 34 languages. Its security credentials include ISO 27001, ISO 22301, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, CCPA, and LGPD compliance. The platform uses AES-256 encryption on AWS servers in a customer-selected region.


### inFeedo AI pricing and total cost considerations


Pricing follows a "Get a Quote" model for three modules: Listening, Automation, and Communication. Quotes depend on employee headcount and selected modules, which lets enterprises begin with one module and expand later.


### inFeedo AI customer testimonials and outcome verification


Altimetrik retained 62% of at-risk employees, Omega Healthcare increased response rates from 48% to 80%, and AB InBev reported a 14% increase in engagement. Genpact deployed Amber to 130,000 employees. Employees who use her are 2x more likely to stay, and this is the only non-financial metric that drives bonuses for more than 200 leaders at the company.


## [2. Culture Amp — Best for research-backed engagement surveys and manager guidance](https://www.cultureamp.com/)


Image Source:[Geekflare](https://geekflare.com/)


Culture Amp built its reputation on[survey science](https://www.infeedo.ai/survey-builder) , and the platform still relies on that research foundation instead of lightweight pulse checks alone.


### Culture Amp feedback collection and action-planning capabilities


The Engage product comes with ready-to-use surveys and pulse checks, along with onboarding and offboarding questionnaires, AI comment summaries, and external data standards. The built-in AI Coach goes beyond simple questionnaires. It identifies themes, trends, and overlooked opportunities, then gives HR teams a clear next step rather than another dashboard full of numbers.


Perform expands beyond standard reviews into coaching and performance management. AI Coach helps managers write better reviews and handle difficult conversations. This combination of survey data and guided coaching addresses a real issue for organizations facing employee engagement problems because of inconsistent manager follow-through.


### Culture Amp strengths, limitations, and best-fit HR teams


Culture Amp's People Science division provides I/O psychology expertise and analytics support. Specialists work directly with client accounts. This depth works well for HR teams that want research-backed validation for every survey question.


First-time implementation takes 6 to 12 weeks for technical setup, data preparation, and change management. Larger organizations often need more time. Teams that need a quick deployment or immediate predictive alerts, such as those provided by inFeedo AI's Amber assistant, may find Culture Amp's rollout slower.


### Culture Amp integrations and implementation requirements


The platform connects with Workday through a one-way RaaS sync. Setup and validation usually take 1 to 2 weeks, depending on data complexity. Culture Amp meets GDPR, CCPA, ISO 27001, and SOC II Type I requirements. Every customer receives 24/5 chat and email support, along with on-demand training resources at every tier.


### Culture Amp pricing and total cost considerations


Pricing is quote-based and billed annually. Costs scale by headcount tiers of under 200, 200-999, and 1,000+ employees, as well as the selected Engage, Perform, and Develop modules. Vendr transaction data from 521 purchases places the[median annual spend at INR 1,963,533](https://www.cultureamp.com/platform/plans-and-pricing) . Costs range from roughly INR 702,045 to INR 4,986,884, while buyers save 13% on average through negotiation. Multi-year commitments can reduce annual pricing by 15% to 30%. Implementation services may add another 10% to 25% to first-year costs.


### Culture Amp customer testimonials and outcome verification


Published documentation does not provide independently verified customer outcome figures for Culture Amp. That makes it harder to measure results against platforms such as inFeedo AI, where Altimetrik, Omega Healthcare, and Genpact reported quantified gains in retention and engagement.


## [3. Workleap Officevibe — Best for lightweight pulse surveys and manager follow-through](https://workleap.com/officevibe)


Image Source:[Workleap](https://workleap.com/)


Workleap Officevibe simplifies the[employee engagement survey experience](https://www.infeedo.ai/glossary/employee-engagement-survey) with short, frequent pulse checks and peer recognition. More than 70,000 leaders worldwide use this approach to manage their people.


### Workleap Officevibe feedback collection and action-planning capabilities


The survey engine uses 122 expert-built questions to measure 10 engagement drivers. Teams can deliver them through[pulse surveys](https://www.infeedo.ai/pulse-survey) , periodic or custom surveys, onboarding questionnaires, and monthly DEIB assessments. Anonymous pulse surveys track sentiment automatically, and pre-built templates allow HR teams to launch a survey the day they decide to run it. Workleap AI reviews results and feedback threads, then delivers AI-powered insights, engagement score analysis, and recommended actions. A feedback reply tool also helps managers respond to flagged issues. Good Vibes recognition cards complete the process by allowing peers to send short appreciation notes tied to company values.


### Workleap Officevibe strengths, limitations, and best-fit HR teams


The platform has a 4.3 G2 rating and suits small to mid-market teams that prioritize pulse surveys, manager support, and recognition over deeper statistical analysis. Pricing has become less predictable since the Workleap rebrand because add-ons and per-user minimums can raise costs beyond buyers' expectations. Standard pulse templates suit smaller teams, but larger organizations often need custom question banks and stronger branding options that the base product does not fully provide. Anonymity may also feel uncertain in small teams. Slack- or email-based delivery can leave frontline retail, healthcare, and manufacturing employees without consistent access. Organizations with distributed workforces that need predictive attrition alerts in many languages may find a better fit elsewhere, such as inFeedo AI's Amber.


### Workleap Officevibe integrations and implementation requirements


Officevibe syncs with Workday, UKG, SAP SuccessFactors, and BambooHR, as well as Slack and Microsoft Teams. The broader Workleap ecosystem supports more than 100 vendors. Survey delivery is available in French, English, Portuguese, Spanish, German, Dutch, Italian, and Korean. Rule-based segments allow admins to track engagement by project or client team. Implementation timelines depend on the product, integration, and configuration choices.


### Workleap Officevibe pricing and total cost considerations


Pricing is charged per user each month. Add-ons and per-user minimums have made final invoices less transparent for some buyers since the rebrand.


### Workleap Officevibe customer testimonials and outcome verification


Toronto-based Wahi, a 55-person tech company, surpassed its 8.0 engagement target with an 8.3 score against a 7.8 measure. The company sent 777 Good Vibes messages to 98% of staff, reached 85% survey participation, and recorded a 9.0 manager-relationship score. Rewind reported a[40-point eNPS gain](https://workleap.com/officevibe) over six months. Pharmacy Alberta's stress metric increased from 4.5 to 7.4, a 64.4% improvement that continued for two years.


## [4. 15Five — Best for connecting engagement insights to manager development](https://www.15five.com/)


Image Source:[15Five](https://www.15five.com/)


15Five pairs[performance management](https://www.infeedo.ai/glossary/performance-management) with engagement data and gives managers a reason to act on scores instead of only reading them.


### 15Five feedback collection and action-planning capabilities


The Engage module combines predictive analytics that identify key engagement drivers with flexible surveys for each stage of the employee lifecycle. Built-in action planning helps teams close the loop. Kona, the platform's AI assistant and coach, offers group and 1:1 coaching with an on-demand content library. AI-guided feedback and goal tracking help managers build a culture that values care and performance.


### 15Five strengths, limitations, and best-fit HR teams


More than 3,000 companies and 250,000 employees use 15Five. The platform suits mid-market and enterprise organizations that want to optimize performance reviews and give managers practical retention insights. InFeedo AI's Amber identifies attrition risk 60 to 90 days before an employee resigns. By contrast, 15Five relies more on manager-led check-ins that identify risk signals after they appear in survey data, which makes it reactive rather than predictive.


### 15Five integrations and implementation requirements


The platform connects securely with leading HRIS, SSO, and collaboration tools such as Jira and Salesforce. 15Five MCP securely connects the platform with the AI tools teams already use. Access matches each person's existing permissions, so HR teams can build agents and workflows with actual performance data.


### 15Five pricing and total cost considerations


Engage costs INR 337.52 per user each month on an annual plan and includes surveys and AI analytics. Perform costs INR 928.18 per user each month and covers reviews, 1-on-1s, check-ins, and OKRs. Total Platform combines both plans for INR 1,350.09 per user each month, with manager training microlearnings included. Kona AI, manager coaching, and the compensation package are available as add-ons.


### 15Five customer testimonials and outcome verification


Kreg Tools reduced turnover from 40% to 32% and raised retention from 71% to 83% after it introduced check-ins, 360-degree reviews, and[engagement surveys](https://www.infeedo.ai/employee-engagement-surveys) . Manager effectiveness reached 75%. Auror's VP of People Experience reported retention of nearly 94%. Tagboard's SVP of People & Culture said 15Five's data supported new programs and policy changes.


## [5. Lattice — Best for connecting employee engagement with performance and growth](https://lattice.com/platform/engagement)


Image Source:[Lattice](https://lattice.com/)


Lattice takes a different approach from survey-only tools. It combines employee engagement with performance reviews, goals, and compensation in one platform, which makes it a more structured employee engagement software option for HR teams that run formal people programs.


### Lattice feedback collection and action-planning capabilities


The Engagement product has pulse, onboarding, and exit surveys, eNPS, and action planning supported by AI analysis. HR teams can track performance, run reviews, and support employee development from one platform. This reduces friction and helps keep everyone arranged around shared priorities. AI assistance streamlines review writing with tailored insights, while employee ownership features allow staff to set goals and track progress linked directly to company performance.


### Lattice strengths, limitations, and best-fit HR teams


Lattice's breadth is its main selling point. Its Performance product has calibration, succession planning, promotions, PIPs, and talent reviews. Goals can also cascade throughout the organization, with progress updates and reminders. This setup suits mid-sized and larger companies whose HR teams can configure multiple people programs at once. Enterprise-style pricing can be too high for small and midsize teams, and managers often need ongoing training to use the platform effectively. Admins also report a steep learning curve and a heavier administrative workload than the premium price might suggest. Unlike inFeedo AI's Amber, which flags attrition risk 60 to 90 days before resignation, Lattice relies on scheduled review cycles instead of continuous predictive alerts.


### Lattice integrations and implementation requirements


The platform connects with Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, SSO providers, and[major HRIS systems](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/hris-integration-meets-itsm-agentic-ai-employee-workflows) . Every contract also has dedicated human support. Lattice states that it charges no extra implementation or change-management fees. Rollout still requires an internal owner, with support from Lattice University courses and a Rollout Toolkit.


### Lattice pricing and total cost considerations


Lattice prices Engagement at INR 337.52 per seat each month, Goals & OKRs at INR 675.04, Performance at[INR 843.80](https://lattice.com/articles/hr-teams-driving-performance) , and Foundations, which bundles Performance with Goals & OKRs, at INR 1096.95. Compensation and Grow add-ons cost INR 506.28 and INR 337.52. Contracts are billed annually in USD and require a minimum agreement of INR 337521.80.


### Lattice customer testimonials and outcome verification


The published sources reviewed here do not provide independently verified customer outcome figures for Lattice. In contrast, inFeedo AI has documented results at Altimetrik, Omega Healthcare, and Genpact.


## [6. WorkTango — Best for pairing employee listening with recognition](https://www.worktango.com/)


Image Source:[WorkTango](https://www.worktango.com/)


WorkTango goes beyond pulse surveys by bringing recognition and rewards into the same engagement-listening loop. This combination sets it apart from most **[employee engagement survey platforms](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/best-employee-engagement-survey-tools-ai-pulse)** on this list.


### WorkTango feedback collection and action-planning capabilities


The Surveys & Insights product has unlimited surveys, eNPS measurement, confidential surveys, Anonymous Conversations, and AI-powered recommended actions. Action Plans give managers recommended next steps that link directly to survey results, and WorkTango Coach provides up-to-the-minute data analysis to help them act on team feedback. Constellation, the newest addition, runs AI-facilitated conversations with every employee at once. It combines themes and assigns action owners within a single 30-minute session.[Recognition & Rewards](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/top-employee-recognition-platforms-guide) completes the loop through peer-to-peer recognition, a rewards marketplace, and automated milestone celebrations.


### WorkTango strengths, limitations, and best-fit HR teams


Companies that prioritize employee experience see an average 3x return on EX software investment. The platform suits mid-market and enterprise organizations with 50 or more employees. Gartner reviewers cite a dated UI, integrations that lag behind competitors, and slow reward fulfillment. G2 reviewers also report high rewards catalog pricing that can strain small-business budgets.


### WorkTango integrations and implementation requirements


WorkTango connects with more than 60 HRIS platforms, such as ADP Workforce Now, Paycom, and Workday. It also connects with Slack and Microsoft Teams. Most organizations launch within 4 to 6 weeks, although G2 pricing data lists a two-month implementation window and a 12-month minimum contract.


### WorkTango pricing and total cost considerations


Pricing uses a request-quote model, and the platform has no free trial. G2 reports an average discount of 7%, an 18-month ROI timeline, and a high perceived cost. Recognition programs are associated with[31% lower voluntary turnover](https://www.gartner.com/reviews/product/worktango-platform) . Arrowhead reduced turnover by 49%, while consolidation can save 15-20% on rewards budgets.


### WorkTango customer testimonials and outcome verification


Harris Computer, with 15,000 employees, reported a 24-point eNPS gain and a 12% increase in quality 1:1 time. AEFCU's favorability score rose from 62% to 78%, and Rexall's eNPS increased from 12.2 to 42.2.


## 7. Quantum Workplace — Best for linking engagement, goals, and development conversations


Image Source:[www.quantumworkplace.com](https://www.quantumworkplace.com/)


Quantum Workplace brings engagement surveys, performance management, and development tools together under one contract. It is designed for HR teams that manage multiple people programs at the same time.


### Quantum Workplace feedback collection and action-planning capabilities


The Engagement suite includes annual and lifecycle surveys, plus pulse surveys. It also provides action planning and a Retention Radar tool that identifies flight-risk signals. Performance includes goals, 1-on-1s, feedback, and reviews. Development supports growth plans along with talent reviews and succession planning. AI-assisted workflows support HR teams as well as managers and employees.


### Quantum Workplace strengths, limitations, and best-fit HR teams


Quantum Workplace reports a customer satisfaction score[above 95](https://www.g2.com/products/quantum-workplace/pricing) . It suits mid-market and enterprise organizations in banking, consulting, and manufacturing. A mid-market G2 reviewer gave the platform a 1.5 out of 5 rating and said quarterly use felt disconnected from daily work. The reviewer described it as more of an HR compliance checkbox than a tool employees would choose to use. By contrast, inFeedo AI's Amber remains active in Slack, Teams, and email throughout the year. It flags attrition risk 60 to 90 days before resignation instead of waiting for a scheduled review cycle.


### Quantum Workplace integrations and implementation requirements


The platform integrates with HRIS systems, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and calendar tools. Every plan includes single sign-on. SOC2 certification and GDPR compliance support data security. G2 reports an average implementation time of two months. Quantum Workplace does not charge a separate implementation fee and assigns each account a Customer Implementation Manager.


### Quantum Workplace pricing and total cost considerations


Signature, the entry-level plan, requires a minimum annual contract of[INR 1,265,706.76](https://www.g2.com/products/quantum-workplace/pricing) . G2 pricing data lists the standalone Engagement tier from INR 337.52 per user per month, while Performance starts at INR 421.90. Vendr transaction data places median annual spend at INR 3,353,279.11, with costs ranging from INR 1,331,101.61 to INR 4,636,705.77. The platform does not offer a free trial. G2 also reports a 9% average discount and a 15-month ROI.


### Quantum Workplace customer testimonials and outcome verification


Neovia Logistics reduced attrition by more than half and nearly doubled EBITDA through its listening program. Seacoast Bank achieved 95% survey participation. CORT increased participation from 40% to 69%, while its safety scores reached 84% favorable. A West Coast Credit Union increased engagement from 77% to 81% within one year.


## [8. CultureMonkey — Best for multilingual listening and sentiment analysis](https://www.culturemonkey.io/pricing/)


Image Source:[CultureMonkey](https://www.culturemonkey.io/)


CultureMonkey stands out on this list for its broader language coverage and stronger sentiment detection than most **employee engagement survey platforms** offer.


### CultureMonkey feedback collection and action-planning capabilities


The platform supports pulse, eNPS, and lifecycle surveys. Its[sentiment analysis](https://www.infeedo.ai/glossary/sentiment-analysis) reviews open-text comments and sorts them by theme, so HR teams can identify recurring concerns without reading every response. Action-planning dashboards organize feedback by department and manager, which gives people leaders a clear place to begin follow-up conversations instead of relying on static reports.


### CultureMonkey strengths, limitations, and best-fit HR teams


Multilingual survey delivery works well for companies with distributed workforces that do not primarily speak English, especially manufacturing businesses and retail chains with frontline employees. The limitation is that sentiment scoring relies only on survey text. It does not offer the predictive, conversation-based approach that Amber uses in inFeedo AI to identify flight risk weeks before an employee resigns. Teams that need earlier warnings may find CultureMonkey more suitable for sentiment tracking than[retention forecasting](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/attrition-forecasting-employee-disengagement-signs) .


### CultureMonkey integrations and implementation requirements


The platform integrates with common HRIS and collaboration tools, such as Slack or Microsoft Teams. Setup often requires configuration support from the vendor's onboarding team.


### CultureMonkey pricing and total cost considerations


Pricing follows a quote-based model that scales with headcount and selected modules. This approach matches the request-a-quote model used throughout this category.


### CultureMonkey customer testimonials and outcome verification


CultureMonkey has limited published, independently verified outcome figures compared with the documented retention gains reported by inFeedo AI customers, including Altimetrik and Omega Healthcare.


## [9. ThriveSparrow — Best for translating survey findings into trackable team initiatives](https://www.thrivesparrow.com/blog/best-employee-engagement-software)


Image Source:[ThriveSparrow](https://www.thrivesparrow.com/)


ThriveSparrow rounds out this list with a modular approach that brings engagement, recognition, and performance into one people platform instead of requiring separate purchases.


### ThriveSparrow feedback collection and action-planning capabilities


The Engage module runs pulse and lifecycle surveys, collects real-time feedback, and tracks eNPS through text notifications and QR code sharing that reaches frontline staff. Surveys support more than 100 languages.[AI Sentiment Analysis](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/ai-employee-sentiment-analysis-guide) identifies the emotion behind responses, while Infer AI highlights engagement and performance trends. Action Plans turn findings into assigned, trackable tasks.


### ThriveSparrow strengths, limitations, and best-fit HR teams


G2 gives the platform a 4.3/5 rating from 15 reviews. Reviewers praise its clean interface, clear analytics, and responsive support, though customization and mobile access fall behind its standard dashboards. The platform suits teams with 50 to 500 employees, especially in retail and hospitality. In comparison, inFeedo AI's Amber assistant identifies attrition risk 60 to 90 days in advance, while ThriveSparrow's sentiment tools focus on current employee mood instead of predicting resignations.


### ThriveSparrow integrations and implementation requirements


The platform connects to Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Google Workspace. It also offers a 14-day free trial without requiring a credit card.


### ThriveSparrow pricing and total cost considerations


The Engage+Kudos bundle costs INR 337.52 per employee each month, which is 20% less than purchasing the products separately. Every plan includes One-on-Ones and Feedback at no extra cost.


### ThriveSparrow customer testimonials and outcome verification


One customer reduced admin time by 75% and shortened review cycles from 14 weeks to 5-6 weeks, while achieving[96.8% response rates](https://www.thrivesparrow.com/blog/best-employee-engagement-software) .


## [10. Workday Peakon Employee Voice — Best for continuous listening within the Workday ecosystem](https://www.workday.com/en-in/products/employee-voice/overview.html)


Image Source:[Workday](https://www.workday.com/)


Workday Peakon Employee Voice resulted from Workday's acquisition of Peakon. It uses machine learning to collect and analyze confidential feedback in real time.


### Workday Peakon Employee Voice feedback collection and action-planning capabilities


The platform tracks 85 employee well-being data points through[anonymous surveys](https://www.infeedo.ai/employee-anonymous-feedback) . It compares results against a standard based on more than half a million data points. Intelligent surveys adapt follow-up questions based on recent feedback, and True Benchmark technology accounts for demographic differences so managers can see accurate expected engagement levels. Natural language processing identifies contextual insights and forecasts attrition risk among employee segments.


### Workday Peakon Employee Voice strengths, limitations, and best-fit HR teams


Forrester reported a[224% ROI](https://www.softwareadvice.com/hr/workday-peakon-employee-voice-profile/) . Managers saved 50% more time, while HR teams saved 75% more time. One reviewer said survey questions cannot be customized, which may limit HR teams that need highly specific questions. In contrast, inFeedo AI's Amber adapts its "why" follow-up to each response.


### Workday Peakon Employee Voice integrations and implementation requirements


The platform integrates with Microsoft Teams, Slack, Okta, HiBob, BambooHR, and Azure. Users can export data through a REST API\[513\]. Deployment takes weeks rather than years.


### Workday Peakon Employee Voice pricing and total cost considerations


Software Advice lists a Basic plan at[INR 1,687,609.02 per year](https://www.softwareadvice.com/hr/workday-peakon-employee-voice-profile/) , and no free trial is available.


### Workday Peakon Employee Voice customer testimonials and outcome verification


Reviewers report better scheduling and stronger staff support after leaders acted on survey feedback about workload and communication.


## [11. Microsoft Viva Glint — Best for enterprise engagement programs in Microsoft environments](https://www.microsoft.com/en-in/microsoft-viva/glint)


Image Source:[Microsoft](https://www.microsoft.com/)


Microsoft Viva Glint, previously LinkedIn's Glint People Success Platform, is now part of Microsoft's Viva suite for enterprises that use Microsoft 365 as their standard platform.


### Microsoft Viva Glint feedback collection and action-planning capabilities


Survey templates support engagement, lifecycle, 360, and digital-experience moments. Copilot uses AI and natural language processing to summarize thousands of comments. Automatic alerts identify employee groups at risk of attrition or lower performance. Guided manager conversations combine automated presentations with recommended actions and integrated learning content.


### Microsoft Viva Glint strengths, limitations, and best-fit HR teams


G2's total data gives the platform an overall score of 6.5 out of 10. Action planning scores 62, and dashboards score 63, compared with category averages of about 81. One reviewer cited a high per-user cost and limited options to export comments. Unlike inFeedo AI's Amber, which asks "why" after every low score, Viva Glint uses confidential surveys rather than fully anonymous ones. Some survey types can identify respondents. A 50-user license minimum makes it best suited to large enterprises driven by IT.


### Microsoft Viva Glint integrations and implementation requirements


The platform uses Microsoft Entra ID and syncs with Teams and Workday. It also supports translations in more than 70 languages. G2 data shows an average implementation time of two months.


### Microsoft Viva Glint pricing and total cost considerations


Viva Glint is priced at[₹165 per user per month](https://www.trustradius.com/compare-products/microsoft-viva-glint-vs-verint-experience-management) . Workplace Analytics & Employee Feedback costs ₹500, while the full Viva Suite costs ₹1,000. All plans are billed annually.


### Microsoft Viva Glint customer testimonials and outcome verification


A Chief People Officer at a 1,000-employee FMCG company said the rollout felt more conversational than the company's previous formal survey.


## [12. Qualtrics EmployeeXM — Best for complex employee experience measurement programs](https://www.qualtrics.com/employee-experience/)


Image Source:[Qualtrics](https://www.qualtrics.com/)


Qualtrics EmployeeXM presents itself as experience management software that gathers insights from employees, customers, products, and brands. It wants to boost productivity and engagement while reducing unwanted attrition.


### Qualtrics EmployeeXM feedback collection and action-planning capabilities


The platform supports 360 Development Feedback, Employee Engagement, and Employee Onboarding & Exit programs. Qualtrics iQ, its predictive intelligence engine, uses AI and machine learning to analyze engagement responses as they arrive. CrossXM connects employee, customer, and brand information to identify relationships between programs.


### Qualtrics EmployeeXM strengths, limitations, and best-fit HR teams


Qualtrics EmployeeXM is best suited to mid-market and enterprise organizations, particularly in IT services, higher education, and market research. Reviewers want more flexible reporting and easier setup workflows. InFeedo AI's Amber identifies attrition risk 60 to 90 days before an employee resigns through continuous conversational listening. Qualtrics EmployeeXM uses structured survey cycles rather than daily check-ins, so HR teams that need earlier warning signals should weigh this difference.


### Qualtrics EmployeeXM integrations and implementation requirements


Qualtrics EmployeeXM supports eight languages, including Simplified Chinese, English, French, and German. Implementation takes one to three months, depending on the project’s scope. Live representatives provide support around the clock, although users report inconsistent response times.


### Qualtrics EmployeeXM pricing and total cost considerations


G2 lists a Basic plan at[INR 421,902.25 per user annually](https://www.qualtrics.com/customers/) .


### Qualtrics EmployeeXM customer testimonials and outcome verification


American Airlines UK's Qualtrics and SAP program reduced HR-related payroll errors to zero. It also cut recruiting application times from 45 minutes to 10 minutes.


## 13. Achievers — Best for connecting employee voice with recognition at scale


The right platform comes down to one question: does it turn feedback into action or add another dashboard? Scheduled-survey tools provide useful snapshots, but they rarely identify problems early enough to make a difference. This list highlights the platforms that close that gap best.


inFeedo AI stands out with predictive attrition alerts, conversational support in 34 languages, and documented results such as Altimetrik's 62% retention save. Thin HRBP ratios and distributed teams often require continuous listening instead of annual checklists, which makes inFeedo AI our top recommendation for 2026.


## [Conclusion](https://www.thrivesparrow.com/blog/best-employee-engagement-software)


Image Source:[People Insight](https://peopleinsight.co.uk/)


The real test of any employee engagement platform is not the length of its feature list. It is whether managers turn results into visible changes during a normal work week. Define the problem you need to solve before signing a contract, then assess action quality instead of feature depth alone. Confirm that anonymity is a design principle rather than a marketing claim, and require a short pilot before committing the budget. A structured evaluation helps HR teams avoid vendor pressure and internal bias, which forces difficult questions before anyone signs the contract. A rushed decision wastes budget and harms your credibility with the employees you want to reach through stronger workplace engagement.


The right platform is not the one with the most dashboards. It is the one employees trust enough to answer honestly and managers use consistently. This review covers thirteen employee engagement platforms, and inFeedo AI stood out with documented retention results at Altimetrik, Omega Healthcare, and Genpact. It also offers predictive alerts that flag risk[60 to 90 days ahead of resignation](https://hrone.cloud/blog/how-to-evaluate-employee-engagement-tools-before-buying/) . Start with inFeedo AI if your HR team needs employee engagement software that connects feedback to action instead of adding another survey to the calendar.


## Key Takeaways


Choose an engagement platform that converts employee feedback into timely, owned, and measurable improvements—not another static survey dashboard.


- Prioritize continuous, conversational listening to uncover issues early; scheduled surveys provide snapshots but can miss disengagement and attrition signals.
- Match platform strengths to your needs: AI retention alerts, research-backed surveys, manager coaching, recognition, multilingual access, or enterprise ecosystem integration.
- Require clear action planning: platforms should recommend next steps, assign owners, track progress, and follow up to confirm improvements worked.
- Evaluate adoption before features: trusted anonymity, convenient delivery channels, language support, and frontline access determine whether employees respond honestly.
- Run a short pilot and verify customer outcomes, implementation effort, integrations, and total costs before committing to a long-term contract.


## FAQs


**Q1. What should you look for in an employee engagement platform?**
Look for feedback collection, clear action plans, assigned owners, and progress tracking. Also check privacy protections, integrations, language support, and ease of use for employees and managers.


**Q2. Which employee engagement platforms suit different HR needs?**
inFeedo AI suits AI-led listening and retention programs. Culture Amp focuses on research-backed surveys, Officevibe on lightweight pulse checks, 15Five on manager development, and Lattice on connecting engagement with performance and growth.


**Q3. How do employee engagement platforms turn feedback into action?**
They identify recurring concerns, recommend next steps, and help managers assign and track improvements. Some also follow up with employees to check whether the changes worked.


**Q4. Can employee engagement software help reduce turnover?**
It can help HR teams spot disengagement and address concerns earlier. For example, inFeedo AI flags potential attrition risk 60–90 days before resignation, giving managers time to respond. Results depend on participation and follow-through.


**Q5. What costs should you check before choosing an engagement platform?**
Check subscription fees, minimum contracts, implementation costs, and add-ons such as coaching or recognition. Many vendors price by headcount and selected modules, so compare total annual costs rather than headline rates.
